, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly upgraded Robert J. Chassell’s role from “founding director” to “co-founder,” stating that the FSF founders are Richard Stallman and Robert J. Chassell. Authoritative sources indicate the Free Software Foundation was founded by Richard Stallman; Chassell was a founding director/treasurer, not a founder. This misinterpretation could lead to an incorrect final answer.
